subject: Request: short-term sandbox insurance credit while PO processes
messages:
From: Alex Jones <alex.jones@medicode.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sundaram <priya.sundaram@medicode.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot access — procurement hold and immediate needs

Hi Ben,

Quick note from the Medicode integration team — our procurement team has the PO queued but the legal redline review pushed the expected sign date out by ~2 weeks. We hit that yesterday when our VP of Engineering asked us to pause running the sandbox workloads to avoid accruing unexpected spend.

We believe Redwood is the best fit for our inference needs and still want to run the two-week expanded pilot (the one you demoed). Can Redwood temporarily extend or provide a short-term insurance credit so our engineering team can finish the end-to-end tests while procurement finishes the PO? If possible, we need roughly $4k of runway to complete a final evaluation.

Attached: current PO draft and a snapshot of our sandbox consumption last 48h. Happy to hop on a 15-min call.

Thanks —
Alex Jones
Director of Integrations
Medicode

Attachments: Medicode_PO_draft.pdf (pdf), sandbox-usage-snapshot.csv (csv)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@medicode.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot access — procurement hold and immediate needs

Alex — thanks for the context and for sharing the docs. I understand the timing pressure. We can usually accommodate short runway requests for customers engaged in an active PO flow.

Proposal: Redwood can offer a one-time "insurance credit" of up to $4,000 to preserve the sandbox and keep the pilot live for 14 days, contingent on: (1) receipt of the PO draft (you sent it) and (2) a purchase-order number or confirmation within 14 days of the credit grant. If we don't see PO progress after 14 days we'll pause access (we'll give a 48-hour notice).

Marissa — can you confirm whether CS needs to set any usage caps or guardrails on the account?
Dev — I flagged this with finance; please weigh in on approval path and whether a simple credit memo is fine for this size.

If agreeable, I can send a brief confirmation email and the simple credit terms so you can share with procurement.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Jones <alex.jones@medicode.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T12:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot access — procurement hold and immediate needs

On Apr 18, 2027, at 10:05 AM, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Alex — thanks for the context and for sharing the docs. I understand the timing pressure. We can usually accommodate short runway requests for customers engaged in an active PO flow.

Hi all — I can apply a 14-day usage cap + the $4k insurance credit to the Medicode sandbox. I'll set hard token caps for the environment and enable prefix caching so you won't hit surprises. Alex, can you confirm which project ID the team is using (if you send that I'll attach the cap to the correct sandbox)?

Also: we'll add a single line item in our credit memo linking the credit to PO number once provided. No further approvals required from CS.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Alex Jones <alex.jones@medicode.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot access — procurement hold and immediate needs

Ben / Marissa — finance reviewed the ask. For a $4k insurance credit we can approve this under the standard pilot-support policy, but we need a PO number or a signature on the PO within 14 days and a contact in procurement for follow-up. If Medicode can provide a procurement contact AND an expected sign date we'll attach that to the credit memo.

Soojin — legal had one note on the credit terms: include a clause that the credit is non-refundable, can only be applied to the current sandbox project, and expires after 14 days. Can you confirm the final language?

Dev Patel
Finance Operations — Redwood Inference

From: Alex Jones <alex.jones@medicode.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sundaram <priya.sundaram@medicode.com>, Michael Lee <michael.lee@medicode.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot access — procurement hold and immediate needs

Thanks everyone — really appreciate the quick coordination.

Procurement contact: Priya Sundaram (pri...@medicode.com), she expects sign-off by 2027-04-29 barring additional redlines. Project ID: medicode-pilot-0427. PO number will be shared as soon as procurement issues it; attaching the observed usage CSV again.

Agreed on the credit terms as described by Dev and Marissa. If you can send the short credit confirmation + terms, I'll circulate to Priya and legal so they have the guardrails while they finish the PO.

Alex Jones
Director of Integrations — Medicode

Attachments: sandbox-usage-snapshot.csv (csv)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@medicode.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T15:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot access — procurement hold and immediate needs

Alex / Priya — confirmed. Per internal approvals, Redwood will apply a $4,000 insurance credit to project medicode-pilot-0427 and enable a 14-day access window starting when we flip the cap. Terms: credit is non-refundable, tied to the project ID, and expires 14 days from activation. We will pause the sandbox after 14 days if no PO number is provided; we'll provide a 48-hour grace notice before pausing.

Next steps for Medicode: please reply with the PO number (or a firm expected sign date) and confirm you accept the terms. Once confirmed we'll: (1) enable the credit and caps, (2) send a short credit memo that includes the PO number line, and (3) share a DocuSign link if you need an authorization signature.

DocuSign draft (if helpful): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning?env=na
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/medicode
